description.text: This intentionally oversized guide exercises page wrapping, automatic pagination, styled text, tips, palette headings, block icons, percentages, missing blocks, page numbers, and navigation arrows. Nothing in this guide is intended to ship as real handbook content.

Pagination check: the palette above is taller than one page. Its heading should stay with at least one entry, and the remaining entries should continue on the following page.

Final page marker. If this appears after several page turns, the complete guide pipeline is working: JSON decoding, registry synchronization, section dispatch, text wrapping, page construction, spread pairing, rendering, clipping, and arrow navigation.
